title: KJDSTA Teachers Protest Outside MBoSE Office Over Exclusion From Government Talks

ai.summary: Khasi Jaintia Deficit Schools Teachers’ Association (KJDSTA) continued protesting outside Meghalaya Board of School Education office on 27 November, alleging government excluded its leadership from a proposed meeting with selected deficit school teachers.

facts.claim: KJDSTA continued its protest outside the Meghalaya Board of School Education (MBoSE) office in Lower Lachumiere, Shillong, on 27th November
facts.quote: KJDSTA continued its protest outside the Meghalaya Board of School Education (MBoSE) office in Lower Lachumiere, Shillong, on 27th November

facts.claim: alleging that the Meghalaya government had excluded its leadership from a proposed 30th November meeting with selected deficit school teachers
facts.quote: alleging that the Meghalaya government had excluded its leadership from a proposed 30th November meeting with selected deficit school teachers

facts.claim: KJDSTA president Boswell S Pala alleged that the Meghalaya government was attempting to divide teachers by inviting selected deficit school teachers to a proposed November 30 meeting without involving the association's leadership
facts.quote: KJDSTA president Boswell S Pala alleged that the Meghalaya government was attempting to divide teachers by inviting selected deficit school teachers to a proposed November 30 meeting without involving the association's leadership

facts.claim: The association maintained that any meaningful engagement with the government should include its representatives
facts.quote: The association maintained that any meaningful engagement with the government should include its representatives

facts.claim: The protest outside the MBoSE office continued on November 27, with teachers from three areas joining the protest
facts.quote: The protest outside the MBoSE office continued on November 27, with teachers from three areas joining the protest

ai.background_note: KJDSTA has been protesting since 11 November over government exclusion from talks regarding deficit school teachers' issues.
